description: Lore documentation factory — deterministic enforcement of BLOCKING DoD rules + upkeep. Paths are resolved relative to the project root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR / payload cwd); JSON is parsed via jq → python3 → sed, warning loudly if none are available. OUTPUT SHAPE: check-image-path.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown or MDX referencing /static/img/, or any image written under docs/ (§6/Rule 1). check-frontmatter.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown/MDX missing valid frontmatter keys (§2/§6). check-no-tooling-refs.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown/MDX referencing the authoring tooling — .claude/ paths, CLAUDE.md citations, or lore:* skill/subagent names (Rule 5/§6). EVIDENCE (§0.1–§0.4): record-evidence.sh keeps an append-only, tiered log of fetches and subagent runs (never blocks) — the model does not author it, and only `verified` entries (a fetching tool actually ran) count as proof, while a URL merely seen inside a Bash command is logged `mentioned`; check-census.sh owns every census rule in two modes — as a Write|Edit hook it blocks (exit 2) on SHAPE (a missing Run contract block, a trusted-source row without its HTTP status and saved raw payload, a zero the raw payload contradicts, a cited payload that is missing, a URL with no verified fetch behind it), and as `--complete <file>` it is invoked by verify-docs.sh at Stop to block on COMPLETENESS (a site census with no observed states, a Figma census with no counted row per manifest source type) — shape at write so the prescribed pre-flight census is writable, completeness at Stop so a placeholder cannot pass; record-validator-run.sh records each lore:doc-validator run and its verdict, matched at the start of a line so prose cannot set it, plus a per-file sha-256 snapshot of docs/ and which files that run actually reviewed (receipt v2), and appends one line per run to an append-only .validator-history (never blocks); remind-census.sh injects a just-in-time reminder when a new docs/ page is created with no census yet, and remind-mass-edit.sh injects the incident-derived checklist before a tree-wide identical edit of docs/ (both never block). verify-docs.sh (Stop) blocks (exit 2) images under docs/, /static/img/ refs, a producing session that left no census at all, an incomplete census, run-contract rows whose status is not exactly satisfied-with-evidence or waived, and documentation that changed since the last green validator run — compared by DIGEST, not mtime, so an unchanged rewrite is a non-event while a one-word edit is a new claim the model must report to the user, to be closed either by a scoped re-validation of exactly those files or by a user-approved .validation-waiver naming each file at its exact current digest; it warns about orphan images and honors stop_hook_active to avoid loops. The evidence artifacts guard against a skipped step, not a deliberate forgery — they are plain files, and an agent with shell access can write one. sync-lore-files.sh (SessionStart) keeps plugin-owned files (lore-methodology.md) in sync with the installed plugin version — silent copy + a one-line notice on update; only touches a project whose CLAUDE.md imports the methodology file. Scope carve-out: templates/** and _templates/** intentional examples are ignored, and .claude/** is ignored by every hook EXCEPT check-census.sh, whose whole job is the evidence artifact that lives there.
